title: Real-world evaluation of the autonomous AI system IDx-DR for diabetic retinopathy
summary: A prospective cross-sectional study of 875 diabetic patients compared the autonomous IDx-DR system with mydriatic fundus examination and ophthalmologist image grading. Without a usable image in miosis for 10.5% and with 26.1% unanalyzable, the system detected severe DR with 94.4% sensitivity and 90.5% specificity when image quality was good; undergrading was rare (4.8%) and exact grading agreement was 54.2%.
ai_technology: IDx-DR autonomous AI diagnostic system for diabetic retinopathy

evidence.tested: Prospective cross-sectional comparison with mydriatic fundus examination and ophthalmologist grading in 875 patients.
evidence.unknown: Evaluation of an existing commercial system in a single setting; image acquisition failures limit use; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: An existing AI system graded retinal images; the study measured its real-world performance and confounders.
